KeysToEntries.Objective.1: Find the Vault Guardian Prime in the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.QuestDesc: Work with Avisk to find a potential shortcut to Fuzan's Volcano
KeysToEntries.Player.NotPlaceShards.1: The vault guardian's core flickers with what seems like sadness.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardian.Name: Vault Guardian
KeysToEntries.Buried.Guardian.Helix.NoSpace.1: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Intro.2: I'd like to suggest an alternative plan. You complete the Crystal Helix, then we access this Shortcut Chamber - whatever it is - and then we undermine whatever Avisk's REAL plan is.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Branch.3: Ah, you found the dismembered vault guardian? Yeah, that was my handiwork. In fact, it's something I would like to discuss...
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.HelixComplete.1: Crystal Helix fragments detected. You carry them, Vault Guardian Prime.
KeysToEntries.Buried.Guardian.PlacedShards.1: The vault shards magnetise into place.
KeysToEntries.Player.Choice.Shards.1: Place 4 vault shards into the core
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.4: Three vault guardians are in possession of them. Recover the fragments… and this unit can restore the Crystal Helix. Then... magical barrier will open.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Name: Vault Guardian Prime
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Return.FoundHelix.1: What are you waiting for? You have the Crystal Helix. Go into the Kalphite Hive, pass the magical barrier, and meet your doo... victory!
KeysToEntries.DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.1: The vault guardian lies shattered, its frame torn apart. Deep score marks cut through the plating.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Response.1: Ooh, very clandestine! Keep your friends close and your enemies closer, right? Close enough to put them in a headlock.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Return.1: Carry on the mission... Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier.
KeysToEntries.Buried.Guardian.Intro.1: The vault guardian lies half-buried in the sand, its frame twisted and silent.
KeysToEntries.Buried.Guardian.NoShards.1: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.QuestDone.1: My objective is complete. I can rest now.
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Return.NoHelix.1: Find my defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the Crystal Helix, and use them together to open up a shortcut to Fuzan in the cave back there.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Name: Zanik
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Intro.1b: You seem to be helping Avisk, but you're too clever to REALLY be helping Avisk. You have an angle on this, don't you?
KeysToEntries.MagicalBarrier.NoHelix.1: The barrier pulses as you touch it, then shoves you back.
KeysToEntries.MagicalBarrier.Complete.1: The Crystal Helix spins brightly in your hands. The barrier shifts and matches the light of the Crystal Helix. It allows you to pass.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.HelixComplete.3: Deliver fragments to this unit. Unit will then repair the Crystal Helix.
KeysToEntries.Objective.4: Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier in the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.Objective.5: Talk to Zanik in the Shortcut Chamber within the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.Objective.2.1: Follow the footsteps in the sand to find who made them
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Intro.2: Our paths cross again, mortal! I have need of someone with legs, hands and an impressionable character. While they are common evolutionary traits, I'm lacking them all here in the desert.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Intro.1: I was wondering when you’d show up!
KeysToEntries.Zanik.NotTalkedtoPrime.1: You made it into the Umbral Sands! It was never in doubt. I'm a little busy now, but shall we catch up later?
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Intro.4: I want you to find my vault guardians and retrieve a Crystal Helix they were carrying. It is the key to a... shortcut which leads directly to Fuzan's Volcano.
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Intro.3: I did have some vault guardians, who had hands at least, but they seem to have expired. It's really rather irritating.
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Intro.5: That interests you, yes? You want to confront Fuzan, don't you? Use the Crystal Helix to access a secret entrance in the nearby cave. Help me and we both benefit.
KeysToEntries.MagicalBarrier.Intro.1: A wall of energy blocks the path. The air hums with power.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.3: Mission handover: the Crystal Helix was… shattered into three fragments.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.4: The last rests near some eggs of the kalphite... on the surface...
KeysToEntries.Objective.2: Find 3 missing vault guardians and recover their Crystal Helix fragments
KeysToEntries.DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.2: The core housing has been pried open. If the Crystal Helix was here, it has been taken.
KeysToEntries.DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.3: Small footprints lead away from the ruined guardian. They look like they belong to something goblin-sized.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Intro.3: How does that sound? If you're in, you will be needing this...
KeysToEntries.Zanik.NoSpace.1: Or, at least, you would if you had space. Make some room and then we can go undercover.
KeysToEntries.Objective.3: Return to the Vault Guardian Prime
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Response.3: Fragments withheld. Directive cannot be fulfilled. Return when ready.
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Name: Avisk Crystal
KeysToEntries.Avisk.QuestComplete.1: Going by the lack of colour in the crystal, Avisk is no longer home.
KeysToEntries.Avisk.Return.QuestIncomplete.1: I suppose your mushy mortal mind has forgotten the current objective.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.2: Protocol override. Vault Guardian Prime status will be conferred to new subject. YOU are now Vault Guardian Prime.
KeysToEntries.Objective.6: Break the four crystals in the Shortcut Chamber of the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.MagicalBarrier.NoHelix.2: The barrier seemed to scan you for something, then shoved you back once it found it missing.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Branch.1: It is incredibly good to see you, but we have a problem - a problem we need to align on.
KeysToEntries.Dead.VaultGuardian.NoQuest.1: A decommissioned Vault Guardian. Very odd.
KeysToEntries.Objective.7: Return to Zanik in the Shortcut Chamber within the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.PitVaultGuardian.Intro.4: The light in its core fades.
KeysToEntries.PitVaultGuardian.Intro.3: Take the Crystal Helix fragment… Complete the task…
KeysToEntries.PitVaultGuardian.Intro.2: Kalphite assault… overwhelming. Game over man... Game over...
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Response.2: You better believe something is off! Avisk has zero interest in finding a shortcut to Fuzan. It's a big old stinking ruse.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.3: One was captured... in this cave. An obstruction pins the unit in place.
KeysToEntries.VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.2: One lies buried… outside... within a ruin of some kind.
KeysToEntries.Zanik.Return.QuestComplete.1: Thanks for helping with that dragonkin buffoon. I slipped a dagger into the vein of consciousness within his crystal. It's only a setback for him, as he will have other crystals for his mind to retreat into.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.QuestComplete.1: Avisk 0, Team Adventurers 1. We should get out of here.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.1: Phew! Definitely took the harder route into this cave. Wait a minute - are those crystals the same as the one outside?
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.2: Avisk is everywhere, mortals! Adventurerer, complete your quest. All that remains is for you to jump into the hole with the Crystal Helix. It will take you directly to Fuzan!
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.3: Ha! Like we'd believe that, you goofy carbon deposit! Notice how there's heat coming from the hole? Avisk must want the Crystal Helix melted in the lava or geyser that lies down there.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.4: Of course! Avisk wants to diffuse his consciousness to the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen! In what world was that plan going to work, Avisk?
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.5: Don't listen to the goblin! Jump into the hole like a good mortal!
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.Intro.6: Pffrt. What do you say we play a bit of whack-a-crystal? Get your pickaxe out.
KeysToEntries.AviskChoir.Name: Choir of Avisk Crystals
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.1: That should be it! We've undermined his plan to mind-meld with the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen. Who knows what THAT might have been like.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.3: All that's left is for me to deal with the giant Avisk crystal on the surface.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.4: Here, have a reward for trusting me over that fancy pebble. I found it in a tunnel that led into this cave. Looks impressive.
KeysToEntries.Zanik2.NoSpace.1: Er, could you clear out some of the stuff in your inventory? I can't give you the reward with so much in there.
KeysToEntries.Crystal.Desc.1: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.
KeysToEntries.Crystal1.Shattered.1: The vein within the crystal pops disgustingly.
KeysToEntries.Crystal1.Shattered.2: You can't destroy Avisk! I have many places like this - full of my consciousness.
KeysToEntries.Crystal2.Shattered.2: Perhaps we could work together? You can have Ghornfell. I have no use for Ghornfell.
KeysToEntries.Crystal3.Shattered.1: The chamber shakes as you throttle the vein.
KeysToEntries.Crystal3.Shattered.2: Must I be humiliated? Why am I always the one who is shamed?
KeysToEntries.Crystal4.Shattered.1: You yank the vein out of the pedestal.
KeysToEntries.Crystal4.Shattered.2: Don't think that this is the end. We will meet again, puny human.
KeysToEntries.MagicalBarrier.Name: Magical Barrier
KeysToEntries.CrystalHelixShard.Name: Crystal Helix Fragment
KeysToEntries.CrystalHelixShard.Desc: A broken fragment of the Crystal Helix
KeysToEntries.CrystalHelix.Name: Crystal Helix
KeysToEntries.CrystalHelix.Desc: This is the fully restored Crystal Helix, which will grant passage through the magical barrier within the Kalphite Hive
KeysToEntries.Vein.Name: Vein of Consciousness
KeysToEntries.Zanik.PostObjective: Keep working on that Crystal Helix. I'm going to see if there's another way past that magical barrier.
